title: Runtime logs
scope: Search covers limited retained logs from this gateway process only. This is diagnostic history, not an audit trail or proof of data delivery. The browser keeps at most 1,000 records and 2 MiB.
scopeHelp: Each exact ID independently narrows retained events. Leave empty for no restriction; use IDs, not names or addresses. Apply filters to update the view.
actionableHelp: Historical events with a suggested action or unknown state, not a list of current unresolved faults. Missing events or recovery records do not establish health.
historyUnknown: Current fault or recovery status is unknown where history is missing. Open the runtime monitor to inspect current rule evidence.
invalidId: Invalid ID format. Enter a complete ID.
controlsHelp: Pause and clear affect this browser only. Acquisition and logging continue; no server records or files are deleted.
deniedHelp: Local-only access: open the gateway page on its own computer using localhost or a loopback address. Remote-only binding and proxy access cannot expose logs. Automatic retries have stopped.
failedHelp: Logs could not be loaded safely. Check that the gateway is running, then retry. No raw error details are shown.
reset: The gateway process restarted. Earlier process history is unavailable.
gap: Some capture history is missing. Available records do not represent continuous capture.
fileGap: Diagnostic files have missing history. The in-memory view and persisted file history have separate loss boundaries.
truncated: Some displayed content was truncated, or older browser rows were removed to stay within memory limits.
degraded: Diagnostic storage is degraded. Logs may be missing from disk; acquisition is independent of this viewer.
storageDisabled: Diagnostic file storage is disabled; these logs are retained in memory only.
counters: Capture drops: {{dropped}} · Retention evictions: {{evicted}} · Subscriber overflows: {{overflow}}

domain.unavailableImpact: This record cannot safely identify an operation or its result. No settings action is available.
domain.receiptOwnEffect: This receipt proves only its own effect; it is not readback, cleanup or aggregate proof.
domain.currentSettingsHelp: Opens current settings. The original source or mapping revision remains historical event context, not a historical snapshot.
domain.groupSettingsHelp: The original group revision remains a history hint. The settings page independently checks the current revision.
domain.navigationOnly: Navigation only — no retry, skip, activation or DDL is executed.

reasons.none: No failure indicated by this event

source.applied: The observed source input was applied to acquisition runtime, not SQL delivery.
source.rejected: This source runtime update was not confirmed; this event does not establish the current configuration.

collector.failed: The final acquisition result failed for this frozen source identity. Delivery is a separate stage.
collector.recovered: Acquisition recovered for the matching source episode; this is not SQL commitment.

mapping.failed: The executed mapping failed for this binding; raw values and transform errors are not shown.
mapping.recovered: The matching mapping result recovered; this does not prove downstream SQL delivery.

group.applied: Reconciliation observed intake active for this original revision; this is not current-state or SQL proof.
group.paused: New intake was paused; historical delivery backlog may remain.
group.retiring: This original revision is retiring; historical delivery backlog may remain.

delivery.retrying: The frozen output remains in delivery retry; SQL commitment is not confirmed by this event.
delivery.blocked: Delivery is blocked for this frozen revision; inspect current evidence before taking any action.
delivery.quarantined: A finalized output is quarantined; it is distinct from quarantined input samples.
delivery.unknown: SQL commitment is not confirmed. Missing evidence is not a success or safe retry authorization.
delivery.first-confirmed: The attached receipt proves only its own effect, not all outputs, readback or cleanup.
delivery.recovered: A matching runtime receipt confirms this effect. It does not prove every pending output was delivered.
delivery.summary: The count describes observed transitions. The attached receipt proves only its own effect, not an aggregate receipt.

counter-replay.quarantined: Accepted input samples await original immutable evidence; they are not finalized delivery outputs.

recording.refused: Original ownership evidence refused intake. Pending input samples are not delivery output counts.

quota.recovered: Capacity recovered for the original quota scope only; this is not resumed intake or SQL commitment.
quota.refused: The configured storage quota refused durable intake; existing historical delivery remains separate.

repair.completed: The schema operation completed; historical data recovery is not implied.
repair.blocked: The repair operation did not complete successfully. This event does not authorize another repair.

cutover.applied: The confirmed cutover operation references the original revisions; it does not establish data delivery.
cutover.rejected: The cutover operation was rejected; inspect current evidence without substituting a same-name group.

legacy.safeRequestSummary: Only a safe request summary is shown.
legacy.suppressedImpact: This record cannot be safely presented. No operation or system health is inferred.
legacy.transportOnly: Connection status describes this log feed only, not acquisition, recording intake, SQL commitment, readback or cleanup.

startup.begin: The gateway process began startup. This is not acquisition or delivery evidence.
startup.ready: The embedded web service reported ready; acquisition and SQL commitment remain separate.
startup.failed: Startup did not complete. Review the fixed diagnostic code and local configuration.
startup.config_invalid: Check the configured values. No raw configuration or credentials are shown.
startup.path_ambiguous: Configure one explicit absolute database location; no private path is displayed.
startup.path_unusable: Check access permissions for the configured data location.
startup.owner_busy: Another gateway owner is active for this database. Do not bypass ownership protection.
startup.log_unavailable: Check the managed diagnostic location and permissions; missing logs do not establish health.
startup.tray_failed: The desktop control icon could not be initialized.
startup.bind_failed: Check the configured listening port. This is a process observation, not acquisition proof.
startup.assets_missing: Use a complete product build containing the embedded application assets.
startup.database_linked: Use one canonical database location so journal sidecar locations are unambiguous.
startup.db_open_failed: The selected database could not be opened; raw driver details are not shown.
startup.db_ping_failed: The selected database did not pass its connection check. This is not a delivery result.
startup.migration_failed: Preserve existing data and review diagnostics; no automatic repair is offered here.
startup.service_failed: Application services could not initialize. Review current runtime evidence separately.
startup.pipeline_failed: The data pipeline could not initialize; no acquisition or SQL outcome is established.

runtime.started: The runtime process reported started; this does not prove successful acquisition, intake or SQL commitment.
runtime.degraded: Review current runtime status. This process observation does not identify a source or prove delivery.
runtime.share_degraded: Review current output status; local sharing and SQL delivery are separate.
runtime.group_failed: Review current recording evidence. This legacy observation has no verified group identity or receipt.
runtime.stopped: The runtime process reported stopped; pending delivery and SQL outcomes remain separate.

shutdown.begin: Shutdown began; this does not establish that pending data was delivered.
shutdown.finalizing: Local diagnostic finalization does not imply delivery completion.
shutdown.complete: Process shutdown completed; acquisition, SQL commitment, readback and cleanup are separate evidence.
shutdown.timeout: Shutdown completion has not been confirmed.
shutdown.failed: A shutdown phase failed; completion has not been confirmed.

http.access: An HTTP request completed; HTTP success does not prove acquisition, intake or SQL commitment.
http.request: An HTTP request completed; HTTP success does not prove acquisition, intake or SQL commitment.
http.recovered: The HTTP handler recovered a fault; this is not acquisition recovery or SQL commitment.
http.recovery: The HTTP handler recovered a fault; this is not acquisition recovery or SQL commitment.
http.server_error: The HTTP server reported an error; raw exception details are suppressed.

raw.suppressed: Unclassified diagnostic content is hidden. This is not evidence of a healthy system.
